```yaml
architecture:
  style: clean-architecture
  layers:
    - name: domain
      kind: domain
      directories:
        - src/domain/**
      file_patterns:
        - src/domain/**/*.ts
      roles:
        - entity
        - value-object
        - repository-interface
      decorators: []
    - name: application
      kind: application
      directories:
        - src/application/**
      file_patterns:
        - src/application/**/*.ts
      roles:
        - use-case
        - dto
        - application-service
        - repository-interface
      decorators: []
    - name: presentation
      kind: presentation
      directories:
        - src/presentation/**
      file_patterns:
        - src/presentation/**/*.ts
      roles:
        - controller
        - middleware
      decorators: []
    - name: infrastructure
      kind: infrastructure
      directories:
        - src/infrastructure/**
      file_patterns:
        - src/infrastructure/**/*.ts
      roles:
        - repository-impl
        - orm-entity
      decorators: []
    - name: main
      kind: infrastructure
      directories:
        - src/main/**
      file_patterns:
        - src/main/**/*.ts
      roles:
        - application-service
      decorators: []
default_exclude_paths:
  - "node_modules/**"
  - "dist/**"
  - "**/*.spec.ts"
  - "**/*.test.ts"
fitness_overrides:
  - id: FF-P01
    enabled: true
    reason: "Domain must stay free of frameworks; this repo uses express and knex, so both are added to the forbidden imports."
    params:
      forbidden_imports:
        - "@nestjs/*"
        - typeorm
        - express
        - knex
        - prisma
        - "@prisma/*"
        - sequelize
```
